checks.text: The page shows the heading "Number to Words".
Typing 42 in the field labelled "Number" shows "forty-two" in the output pane.
Typing 1000 in the field labelled "Number" shows "one thousand" in the output pane.
Typing 1234567 in the field labelled "Number" shows "one million two hundred thirty-four thousand five hundred sixty-seven" in the output pane.
Typing 0 in the field labelled "Number" shows "zero" in the output pane.
Typing 99 in the field labelled "Number" and selecting "UPPER" in the select labelled "Case" shows "NINETY-NINE" in the output pane.
Typing 500 in the field labelled "Number" and clicking the button "Copy" shows the toast "Copied to clipboard" and the output pane still shows "five hundred".
Typing 77 in the field labelled "Number" and clicking the button "Save to history" adds a row to the history table containing "77" and "seventy-seven".
Reload keeps the history row with "77" and "seventy-seven" visible in the table.
